notes: Expected W and p-values were calculated independently from the AS R94 equations
using Python standard-library NormalDist for the normal quantile and CDF.
These values serve as numerical regression references for Statify.
references: Royston P. (1993). Approximating the Shapiro-Wilk W test for non-normality. Statistics and Computing, 2, 117-119.
Royston P. (1995). Remark AS R94: A Remark on Algorithm AS 181. Applied Statistics, 44, 547-551.
Blom G. (1958). Statistical Estimates and Transformed Beta Variables. Wiley.
